source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    colors = (5, 2, 5, 0)
    inset = 0

        r0, r1 = top + inset, bottom - inset
        c0, c1 = left + inset, right - inset
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r0][c] = color
            out[r1][c] = color
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            out[r][c0] = color
            out[r][c1] = color
        inset += 1
    return out

def hollow(n, h, w, top, left):
    g = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    bot, right = top+n-1, left+n-1
    for c in range(left, right+1): g[top][c] = g[bot][c] = 5

    return x

        nrows,ncols=int(m.group(2)),int(m.group(3))
        def parse_rows(block):
            rows=[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in block.splitlines() if line.strip()]
            return rows
        gi=parse_rows(m.group(4)); go=parse_rows(m.group(5))
        allpairs.append((int(m.group(1)),gi,go))
checks=[(i,len(inp),len(inp[0]),len(out),len(out[0]),transform(inp)==out) for i,inp,out in allpairs]
print(checks)
